purpose: Small source-linked research notes for facts or gaps that should stay visible while the normalized datasets evolve. These are not authoritative game records; each note points to the source that should be rechecked before promotion into canonical data.
rules: Every factual note needs at least one source URL.
Unknown League values stay unknown; Catalyst history is context, never an Equilibrium default.
Official Jagex beats current Wiki, which beats current experimentally verified community research when sources disagree.
Asgarnia is the canonical region name throughout this project.

notes.title: Daily League reveals
notes.body: Relic and Blessing details are reveal-dependent through launch. Keep unrevealed nodes empty and refresh the League datasets from official material rather than extrapolating Catalyst effects.

notes.title: Region quest auto-completions
notes.body: The official per-region auto-completed quest lists are still the missing authority for quest state. Do not infer auto-completion just because a quest is geographically inside an unlocked region.

notes.title: Asgarnia boundary
notes.body: Use Asgarnia as the single planner region name for the full mapped area containing Falador, Taverley, Burthorpe, Death Plateau, Trollheim, Troll Stronghold and the God Wars Dungeon approach.

notes.title: Daemonheim belongs to Forinthry
notes.body: Treat Daemonheim and Dungeoneering access as requiring the Forinthry/Wilderness region in the working Equilibrium map.

notes.title: Catalyst relics are historical baseline only
notes.body: Catalyst relics, tasks, trophies and League-only items are useful for comparison and asset reuse, but their mechanics must not be copied into Equilibrium without a current source.

notes.title: Use the post-March-2026 combat model
notes.body: Any combat table imported from older guides must be rechecked against Combat Style Modernisation and subsequent patches before it becomes optimizer-grade data.

notes.title: July 20 progression values supersede older guides
notes.body: Fletching, Agility, Divination, GWD progression, Invention perk availability and several resource loops changed in the July 20 Mid-Game Rebalance. Older method tables need explicit revalidation.

notes.title: Do not import legacy aura assumptions
notes.body: Aura mechanics changed in the 2026 overhaul, so older PvM/training assumptions involving aura uptime or effects need current verification.

notes.title: Havenhythe is live 2026 content
notes.body: Havenhythe content should be sourced from current pages and 2026 updates rather than old world-map assumptions; its training and progression value is still changing as the rollout finishes.

notes.title: Training guides have mixed freshness
notes.body: Do not rank a route numerically when its Wiki training page carries an outdated or incomplete warning. Preserve the method as a candidate and leave the optimizer-grade rate blank until a current benchmark exists.

notes.title: Game assets keep their exact source trail
notes.body: Every harvested binary must retain a canonical subject page, exact source/file page, direct retrieval URL and local hash. Unresolved art stays unresolved rather than being replaced with generated lookalikes.
